title: Unofficial Adrenaline Reforged
description: Unofficial NeoForge port of Adrenaline, the lightweight Fabric performance modpack, focused on improving rendering, logic performance, and memory usage without changing vanilla looks or features.
body:
# Unofficial Adrenaline Reforged

**Unofficial Adrenaline Reforged** is an unofficial NeoForge port/recreation of **Adrenaline**, the lightweight Fabric/Quilt performance modpack.

This project aims to bring the same performance-first idea to NeoForge: improving rendering performance, logic performance, memory usage, and general efficiency while keeping Minecraft’s vanilla look and features intact.

The modpack is designed to stay simple and lightweight. It does not aim to include unnecessary quality-of-life mods, content mods, visual overhauls, or redundant performance mods. Instead, it serves as a clean performance foundation that players can build on by adding their own preferred mods.

## Beta Notice

This modpack is currently in beta. Some mods, settings, or optimizations may change in future versions as better NeoForge alternatives become available.

## Disclaimer

This project is unofficial and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or maintained by the original Adrenaline team. If you are looking for the original Fabric/Quilt version, please use the official Adrenaline modpack.
